title: Instance
hosted: This instance is configured by its server environment. Settings here are read-only.

restart: Restart AskCalls to apply this change.
restartBanner: Restart AskCalls to apply the database change.

signIn.localHint: Email with a passkey or a password. Required in offline mode.

users.count: {n, plural, one {# account on this instance} other {# accounts on this instance}}

offline.blockers: {n, plural, one {# setting reaches the internet. Fix it to turn offline mode on.} other {# settings reach the internet. Fix them to turn offline mode on.}}

offline.databaseHint: Move the database inside your network: askcalls backup, switch, askcalls restore.

setup.label: Setup steps
setup.noAdmin: This instance has no admin yet. The account you create in the last step becomes the admin.

token.title: Enter the setup token
token.body: AskCalls printed a one-time setup token in the server log when it started. It is also in the setup-token file in the data folder.
token.label: Setup token
token.wrong: That token doesn't match. Copy it again from the server log.

setup.changeLater: Everything here can be changed later in Admin, except the database once it holds data.

db.title: Choose a database
db.builtinBody: PGlite, stored in {path} on this machine. For one person or a small team.

storage.title: Choose storage
storage.fsBody: Recordings are stored in a folder on this machine.
storage.s3Body: MinIO, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, AWS S3 or any S3-compatible service.

signIn.title: Choose how people sign in
signIn.localBody: Email with a passkey or a password. Works without internet access.

signIn.emailBody: Sends a sign-in link through your SMTP server.
signIn.none: Choose at least one sign-in method.

ai.llmLocalBody: An OpenAI-compatible server on your network, such as Ollama or vLLM.

offline.title: Offline mode
offline.body: Blocks every request to hosts outside your network. For air-gapped installs.
